About The Game
Master your luck or be consumed by it! Experience the ultimate fusion of explosive 3x3 slot machine jackpots and deep autobattler strategy. Pull the lever to summon units, trigger massive synergies, and crush endless waves of enemies. It's time to put your luck and intellect to the ultimate test!








Pull the Lever! Say Goodbye to Ordinary Defense Games!



Tired of the same old tower defense? We've injected pure dopamine into the very core of combat preparation. Spin the 3x3 slot machine, match the lines, and summon your units. Feeling unlucky? Don't panic. There's nothing quite like the thrill of a single, desperate spin triggering a massive jackpot, filling the screen and summoning a legendary Prism unit to save the day.







Absorb, Evolve, and Reign Supreme



There's no such thing as a useless unit on this battlefield. Weaker units are sacrificed to feed the strong, becoming their flesh and blood. Watch an ordinary 1-star Warrior ascend into a Paladin and finally awaken as the invincible 'Veil', or witness a basic Mage evolve into the dark-magic-wielding 'Necro Lord'. Your branching class choices will completely shift the tide of battle.







Infinite Synergies That Overpower Pure Luck



This isn't just a mindless slot machine where you leave everything to chance. Every time a unit spawns, it rolls from dozens of 'Random Stats'. Combine these with unique unit 'Imprints', powerful Items, and game-changing Cores.

"Massively increases jackpot odds after a failed spin."

"Summons an additional unit upon 3 consecutive wins."

Trigger explosive Core synergies through meticulous planning. Exploit system loopholes, bend RNG to your will, and become the master architect of your own victory.







Forge Your Own Destiny



Will you play it safe, or risk your life for maximum profit? Are you ready? The gold is stacked. Now, it's time to pull the lever!

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

Slotbound uses a custom native loader that verifies runtime DLLs by file size and SHA-256. It also derives the DAT master key from the EXE’s own SHA-256, embedded constants, and DAT header data. Simply replacing steam_api64.dll with an emulator won’t work: the DLL integrity check rejects it.
